message: package-lock.json installs ghshort from a git repository (git+ssh://git@github.com/isaacs/abbrev-js.git#a9ee72ebc8fe3975f1b0c7aeb3a8f2a806a432eb), which depgate.json denies
fix: Use a registry version of ghshort, or set sources.git to "allow" in depgate.json

message: package-lock.json installs ghtgz from a tarball URL (https://codeload.github.com/isaacs/abbrev-js/tar.gz/a9ee72ebc8fe3975f1b0c7aeb3a8f2a806a432eb), which depgate.json denies
